instructions: cashU: local personal finance data of ONE profile. Every answer passes a privacy layer: in 'strict' mode you get shares and percentages, never absolute amounts; identifiers (account numbers, IBANs, person names) are never sent in any mode. Call profile_overview first: it says which modules are enabled and the privacy level. Write tools only create records or proposals; the owner approves proposals in the app. Do not ask the user for raw exports or database files.

tools.description: Start here: enabled modules with setup states and their tools, base currency, privacy level (strict = shares only), data freshness, pending proposals, last reviews.
tools.name: profile_overview

tools.description: Setup steps of a module (done / on / todo) and the next action.
tools.name: setup_status

tools.description: Net worth per currency: bucket shares of assets, asset/liability ratio, 12-month change in %. Absolute amounts only in the 'amounts' privacy mode.
tools.name: networth_breakdown

tools.description: Record that the periodic review of a module (default investments) is done, with notes and (investments) the agenda: the review cards the owner wants followed up, each with a note.

agenda.description: investments review cards the owner wants followed up in the next research run, each with the owner's note

tools.name: mark_review_done

tools.description: Spending in a period (2026, 2026-09 or 2026-Q3; default: the latest month with data): category shares and top merchants with shares, in one currency.
tools.name: spending_breakdown

tools.description: Savings rate %, income/expense ratio, months with a deficit over the last N months.
tools.name: cashflow_summary

tools.description: Recurring payments (likely subscriptions): merchant, cadence, share of monthly spending.
tools.name: recurring_payments

tools.description: Merchants without a category (by count) and the list of category keys for set_merchant_category.
tools.name: uncategorized_merchants

tools.description: Teach the profile a category for a merchant (a learned rule; also re-categorizes its transactions). merchant: the name as listed, or a payee:... reference.
tools.name: set_merchant_category

tools.description: Validate a cashu-budget-import document (JSON or CSV; e.g. your connector's or converter's output): ok, transaction and balance counts, date range, currencies, and issues by kind with row numbers and field names, no values. Nothing is imported.
tools.name: validate_budget_import

tools.description: Per loan: interest rate, remaining months, payoff date, paid share, installment as a share of income (when the budget module is on).
tools.name: loans_summary

tools.description: Portfolio: bucket weights vs targets, drift in pp and band flags, unrealized %, cash weight, data freshness, last rule run, warnings, accounts (generated labels).
tools.name: portfolio_overview

tools.description: Per instrument: symbol, name, weight, unrealized %, tags, bucket, valuation mode, holding days, open signals, thesis flag, the model recommendation (buy_asap | buy | hold | reduce | exit_asap | null), plan_freshness (state fresh | maybe_outdated | outdated and reason codes; null without a recommendation), hints (which of the owner's own rules apply now: code, severity rule|review|info, params as fractions; main first); cash weights per account.
tools.name: positions

tools.description: Rule and alert signals: rule, scope, measured vs threshold (as ratio / pp / days), severity, polarity (positive | negative | neutral), source (rule | alert | research | plan), snooze, age, decisions. status: open (default), history or all.
tools.name: signals

tools.description: The owner's periodic review (strategy.yaml review:): name, every (week | 2weeks | month), day, cards in order (world, sectors, positions, events, ideas, calendar, decide), due, next_on; since = the last review's date (else 7 days ago), last_review {done_at, notes, agenda = the cards the owner sent to the agent {card, note}}; card_sources = which tool has each card's facts; calendar: the next 14 days (high-impact macro releases, earnings of held / watched US instruments, research note events), stale when a public feed could not be refreshed.
tools.name: review_context

tools.description: Strategy validation issues (line / column), rules, inactive rules, version history.
tools.name: strategy_status

tools.description: Retrospective metrics computed locally from the transaction history: activity gaps, deposits per year, sells after drawdowns, buys after run-ups, price change after sales, holding days of winners vs losers, fees as % of turnover, concentration over time.
tools.name: history_metrics

tools.description: Position theses (entry type, thesis, invalidation, exit and size plans) with the model recommendation, optionally of one instrument (id, symbol or ISIN).
tools.name: theses

tools.description: Structure of a broker export or bank statement file (CSV, TSV, JSON, XLSX): sheets, header row, columns, inferred types, row counts and masked sample rows (numbers as their format, free text as token shapes; amounts, identifiers and names never shown). The blind route: when the user hands you the file itself, read it directly.
tools.name: inspect_export

tools.description: Validate a cashu-format file (or a CSV with a mapping): counts and errors by kind with row numbers, no values. MCP never makes the app run code: convert other exports yourself first, or write a connector (propose_connector).

mapping.description: generic CSV mapping: YAML text or a path to a .yaml/.yml file

tools.name: validate_import

refused.converter: MCP calls never make the app run code: run a one-off converter yourself (python3 <script> <export> <output.csv>) and pass the cashu-format output file as path, or write a connector (propose_connector), which the app runs only after the owner approves it in Ustawienia > Konektory

tools.description: Save the model's recommendation for one instrument after reviewing current research, the owner's thesis and invalidation, portfolio construction, strategy and history. This is an opinion for the owner to evaluate, not a decision and never a trade. `reason`: one or two short Polish sentences (max 280 characters) the app shows under the thesis; no amounts.
tools.name: set_recommendation

tools.description: End-of-research recommendation gate. Save changed or missing model recommendations, preserve omitted existing ones, and commit only when every eligible instrument in scope (all = held + watchlist) has a recommendation. Use this once at the end of a routine or full refresh; it returns expected / covered / missing counts. Opinions only, never decisions or trades.

recommendations.description: Changed and missing recommendations: {instrument, recommendation, reason}. Existing omitted recommendations are preserved.

tools.name: set_recommendations

tools.description: Record what the owner decided about a signal (bought, sold, held, ignored, other) with a reason; acknowledges the signal. Never books a trade.
tools.name: record_decision

tools.description: Create or update the thesis of a held instrument (id, symbol or ISIN).
tools.name: upsert_thesis

tools.description: Propose a new strategy (strategy.yaml + strategy.md). Validated locally; stored as a proposal the owner approves in the app (then it becomes a new version). dry_run: validate only.
tools.name: propose_strategy

tools.description: Propose a rule: a built-in kind (e.g. drawdown_from_high) with params, or a custom expression (params: scope, message, id, severity, cooldown_days, filters). Validated with the expression compiler and backtested on the profile's history (how often it would have fired). dry_run: validate and backtest only, store nothing.
tools.name: propose_custom_rule

tools.description: Propose importing a file into a brokerage account (account: the generated label or id from portfolio_overview). path: a cashu-format file or a CSV with a mapping (MCP never makes the app run code). Runs the preview and stores a pending import the owner commits in the app.

mapping.description: generic CSV mapping: YAML text or a path to a .yaml/.yml file

tools.name: propose_import

refused.converter: MCP calls never make the app run code: run a one-off converter yourself (python3 <script> <export> <output.csv>) and pass the cashu-format output file as path, or write a connector (propose_connector), which the app runs only after the owner approves it in Ustawienia > Konektory

tools.description: The profile's alerts (status: live = active, triggered or snoozed (default), all, or one status) with params, polarity, severity, last check and the open signal; plus the agent alert limit.
tools.name: alerts

tools.description: Create an ACTIVE alert (source agent) from the fixed catalog: price_above / price_below {level}, change_pct {window_days, threshold, direction up|down|any}, drawdown_from_high {window_days, threshold}, new_high {window_days}, sma_cross {window_days, direction above|below}, weight_above / weight_below {threshold, bucket?}, custom {expression, bucket?}, range_breakout {window_days 10-260 (30), max_range_pct 0.01-0.30 (0.08), direction up|down|any} (the close leaves a narrow range of the previous sessions), volume_spike {window_days 5-260 (20), multiple 1.5-20 (2.5)} (volume vs its average). instrument: id, symbol, ISIN or Yahoo symbol of a held or watched instrument (add_to_watchlist first). Thresholds are fractions (0.1 = 10%), window_days counts sessions. At most 50 live agent alerts per profile. Conditions on hard data only.
tools.name: add_alert

tools.description: Mute an alert (any source): it stops being checked and its open signal closes; the owner can re-arm it in the app.
tools.name: mute_alert

tools.description: Watched instruments (not necessarily held): last close, 1-day / 1-month change, 52-week high and distance, alerts count, the model recommendation (buy_asap | buy | hold | null), plan_freshness (state fresh | maybe_outdated | outdated and reason codes; null without a recommendation), hints (which of the owner's own rules apply now: code, severity, params; main first).
tools.name: watchlist

tools.description: Find an instrument by name, ticker or ISIN (1-60 characters): the profile's own instruments (local, with state held | watched | saved) and listings found online on Yahoo / OpenFIGI (remote, state new, with the exact Yahoo symbol and exchange; remote_status ok | unavailable | skipped). Use it before add_to_watchlist when the market is not obvious.
tools.name: search_instruments

tools.description: Watch an instrument by ticker with its market (VWCE.DE, PKN.WA, AAPL.US, NVDA:XNAS) or ISIN; when the market is not obvious pass an exact Yahoo symbol from search_instruments. A new listing is checked against its Yahoo price chart (its real currency); if that check fails the symbol is kept as a guess (exchange / currency help when the market is unknown). An instrument removed from the watchlist earlier is restored with its old note and tags (restored = true). It joins the daily price refresh.
tools.name: add_to_watchlist

tools.description: Stop watching an instrument (item id from watchlist). Nothing is deleted: its alerts, theses, research notes, note and tags stay, and add_to_watchlist restores it.
tools.name: remove_from_watchlist

tools.description: Context for a research run: held instruments (weights as fractions) and watched ones, each with its current model recommendation and recommendation date (null means the final set_recommendations gate must receive it), with its market segment (segment, segment_source owner | agent | auto | null), thesis (entry type, thesis, invalidation, exit plan) and research state (thesis health, relation counts, 8-week sentiment, last researched); segments: what moved the portfolio this week and over 4 weeks by market segment (weight, contribution, return, instruments, trend_1w / trend_4w = the equal-weighted price move of its held and watched instruments, members, last_note_at, note_this_week; briefs = up to 3 active brief notes (headline, why) the owner reads under the topic, newest first; thesis = the topic thesis {text, invalidation, draft, created_by, updated_at} or null; valuation = the newest sourced valuation {pe, forward_pe, eps_growth, pe_avg_5y, basis, observed_at} or null; watched-only topics with weight 0), currency and unassigned; topic_thesis_cooldown: topics whose thesis the owner deleted (no new draft before until); segment_catalog; macro: the five macro regime cards (state_label, summary, plain = the beginner sentence the owner sees until a brief exists, brief = the active macro brief {headline, why, supports, risks} or null, since (null + since_open + since_min when the state began before the data), metrics as text, stale, missing, last_note_at, note_this_week; public data) and macro_catalog (their note keys); the strategy's entry types and candidate criteria, open and dismissed (cooldown) candidates, known upcoming events, owner_review (the owner's last weekly review: note and agenda = the review cards the owner sent to the agent {card, title, note}; answer them in this run), the last run, limits (incl. the weekly novelty limits) and boundaries.
tools.name: research_context

tools.description: Research notes stored since a date (default the last 30 days; by storing time), newest observation first, incl. dismissed ones (rejected by the owner: never add them again).

segment.description: only this market segment's or macro regime's notes

tools.name: research_notes

tools.description: Open a research run. scope: {held: true, watchlist: true, candidates: true, segments: [segment or macro keys], instruments: [ids or symbols], scheduled: false (true for the scheduled routine)}. A run covering the held positions is weekly: per ISO week, weekly runs and notes written without a run cover at most 6 instruments, 2 notes each, and 6 segment notes (strength 3, invalidates and fulfills always pass). A scope with only instruments or segments is on demand (the flags it leaves out default to false) and exempt. full_refresh: true ONLY when the owner explicitly asks for a full fresh research: the run is exempt from the weekly novelty limits and from one brief note per segment and week, never from the duplicate / near-duplicate checks or one non-brief note per segment and week; never together with scheduled. Another run still running is a conflict: finish it first.
tools.name: start_research_run

tools.description: Store one sourced research note (facts and sentiment only; no analytical market view, recommendation, security price prediction, target, amounts or sizes). About a held / watched instrument (instrument: id or symbol from research_context), a market segment (segment: catalog key; no instrument, no candidate; kind macro | trend | news; thesis_relation none; summary <= 400 characters; at most one per segment and ISO week, only when something changed), a macro regime (segment: a macro_catalog key, same rules: only when its state changed since its last note or a dated decisive event happened this week), or, for kind candidate, a new instrument (candidate {symbol_or_isin, name, exchange?, currency?} + details {entry_type, criteria [{text, met, threshold?}], context?, bucket?}). thesis_relation (supports | weakens | invalidates | fulfills | neutral) needs an instrument with a thesis, else none; thesis_field names the thesis field it bears on (fulfills: thesis or exit_plan, a dated fact that the expected outcome happened or the exit target is met, never a sell call). details.event + event_date record a known upcoming event; details.scale (small | medium | large) the size of a community discussion; details.headline the plain-words headline (8-80 characters) the app shows first; details.valuation {pe, forward_pe, eps_growth (fraction), pe_avg_5y, basis} the sourced valuation of a topic or company (published figures, forward ones from the consensus the source states; the app derives cheap / fair / rich, never write that word). Title <= 120, summary <= 1200 characters (Polish). A topic's current assessment and outlook belong in set_topic_market_view, never in note details. invalidates -> action signal, strength 3 -> info signal. A segment or macro note may carry details.brief {headline (8-80, a plain Polish sentence a beginner understands), why (<= 280, plain words), supports [<= 3 x 90] and risks [<= 3 x 90] (macro only: conditions that historically supported / weighed on such a market)}: the owner reads it on the home page; never wzrośnie / spadnie / będzie / prognoz* / kupuj / sprzedaj / cel cenowy, except in a sentence citing an institution's published forecast of a macro or market trend with who, how much and horizon (MFW prognozuje wzrost PKB USA o 2,1 % w 2027; projekcja Fed (dot plot); IEA szacuje popyt), the same in a note summary; never a price, valuation or index forecast, an analyst forecast or your own (prognozujemy); expires_in_days up to 90 (60 recommended). A topic note may carry thesis_relation supports | weakens | invalidates when the topic has a confirmed thesis (research_context segments[].thesis with draft false; thesis_field thesis); such an invalidates note passes the weekly segment cap. At most one brief note and one other note per segment and ISO week (a full_refresh run lifts it for brief notes). A note restating a fact already in a non-dismissed note of the same instrument / candidate / segment from the last 60 days (similar title, brief headline or headline + summary, same polarity, relation and direction) is refused as a near duplicate (count it skipped); a brief whose why changed passes the headline check.

segment.description: market segment of a segment note: equity_global (Akcje globalne), equity_pl (Akcje polskie), equity_em (Rynki wschodzące), bonds (Obligacje i stopy), gold (Złoto i górnicy), energy (Ropa i gaz), power (Energetyka: atom i OZE), metals (Metale i ziemie rzadkie), crypto (Krypto), real_estate (Nieruchomości), semis_ai (AI: chipy i centra danych), software (AI i oprogramowanie), robotics (Robotyka), healthcare (Ochrona zdrowia), financials (Płatności i finanse), consumer (Konsumpcja), games_media (Gry), industrials (Przemysł i obronność), quantum (Komputery kwantowe); or a macro regime (macro note): macro_risk (Rynek akcji), macro_dollar (Dolar), macro_em (Rynki wschodzące), macro_commodities (Surowce), macro_rates (Obligacje i stopy)

sources.description: 1-10 sources: {url (http(s), original publisher), publisher, published_at (YYYY-MM-DD), title?}

tools.name: add_research_note

refused.theme: themes are gone: a market note takes segment (a catalog key from research_context.segment_catalog); company facts go on the instrument

tools.description: Write the topic's ONE current market view, shown to the owner directly under the topic thesis (Ocena teraz / Perspektywa), separate from notes; replaces the previous view (the owner's edit included), so keep it current after each topic research. The topic must have a thesis or your draft (upsert_topic_thesis first). assessment (20-400 Polish characters): the topic's market now (adoption, demand, investment, valuations of the topic as a whole). outlook (20-400): where the topic's market / adoption / demand is heading, resting on at least one quantitative industry estimate of market or demand growth cited as an estimate with who, how much and horizon (e.g. IFR szacuje 575 tys. instalacji robotów rocznie w 2028; IEA szacuje popyt centrów danych na ok. 945 TWh w 2030) plus the main risk; an outlook without a number other than a year / horizon is refused. sources (1-6, required): the reports behind those estimates, {url (http(s), original publisher), publisher, published_at (YYYY-MM-DD), title?}; they replace the stored ones. Refused: buy / sell / hold wording, ratings, a price target, any price, valuation or index move of a security, of shares or of an index (kurs / akcje / notowania / wyceny / S&P 500 ... wzrosną), analyst forecasts.

sources.description: 1-6 sources of the cited estimates: {url (http(s), original publisher), publisher, published_at (YYYY-MM-DD), title?}

tools.name: set_topic_market_view

tools.description: Propose a DRAFT thesis on a market topic (segment: a segment_catalog key, never a macro key; thesis <= 600 characters, invalidation? <= 400, plain Polish, what has to stay true for the topic, never a price forecast or a call). Creates a draft or updates the agent's own draft (invalidation omitted keeps it). The owner's thesis (created_by owner, or a draft the owner confirmed: draft false) is never overwritten: conflict. Propose once for a held topic without a thesis (research_context segments[].thesis null); a topic whose thesis or draft the owner deleted is refused for 90 days (research_context topic_thesis_cooldown).

tools.description: Close a running research run: status done (default) or failed (with a short reason); counts: optional {sources_checked, instruments_covered, segments_covered, candidates_screened, skipped}. The server adds notes, signals and candidates.
tools.name: finish_research_run

tools.description: Set the market segment of a held or watched instrument (instrument: id, symbol, ISIN or alias from research_context; segment: a catalog key, or an explicit null to clear it so the automatic guess applies). A segment the owner set (segment_source owner) is never changed or cleared (conflict); the agent may change its own (segment_source agent). Catalog: equity_global (Akcje globalne), equity_pl (Akcje polskie), equity_em (Rynki wschodzące), bonds (Obligacje i stopy), gold (Złoto i górnicy), energy (Ropa i gaz), power (Energetyka: atom i OZE), metals (Metale i ziemie rzadkie), crypto (Krypto), real_estate (Nieruchomości), semis_ai (AI: chipy i centra danych), software (AI i oprogramowanie), robotics (Robotyka), healthcare (Ochrona zdrowia), financials (Płatności i finanse), consumer (Konsumpcja), games_media (Gry), industrials (Przemysł i obronność), quantum (Komputery kwantowe).

tools.description: Test a connector you are writing (a directory connectors/<id>/ in this workspace), before propose_connector: the app runs a private copy once in the same sandbox as approved runs (Deno connectors: Deno permissions inside the macOS sandbox, imports only from the connector's own files and node: built-ins), detect + convert on `file` (a sample export inside this workspace) for a file connector, or fetch offline with `fixture` (a recorded synthetic API response inside this workspace, passed as the `fixture` param, placeholder secrets, no network) for a fetch connector, then validates the document like the import would. Time limit: detect 10 s, convert / fetch the manifest's timeout_s but at most 120 s (test with a sample that converts within that). Returns a value-free report: manifest facts, each run's outcome, error kind, record count and a fixed message for that kind, the detect match, document validity, counts and issue kinds with their counts. Nothing the connector writes (its error message, stdout, stderr) is ever returned, so give your connector precise error kinds and check rows by the issue kinds. Nothing is installed, approved or recorded.
tools.name: test_connector

refused.approve: only the owner approves a connector, in the app (Ustawienia > Konektory)
refused.install: test_connector never installs; submit the connector with propose_connector
refused.network: test_connector never uses the network: test a fetch connector offline with fixture; real fetches run only after the owner approves the connector in the app
refused.secrets: test_connector passes placeholder secrets; the owner enters real keys in the app

tools.description: Submit a connector for the owner's review: `path` = a connector you wrote (a directory connectors/<id>/ in this workspace with connector.yaml and its code; the contract is the import-builder skill's references/connectors.md), or `catalog_id` = an entry of the connector catalog shipped with the app (listed by connectors()). It is installed as pending (an installed one is replaced and waits for approval again). The app runs an installed connector only after the owner approves it in the app (Ustawienia > Konektory); MCP calls never install as approved and never approve. Returns id, status, hash prefix, module, kind, allowed hosts and secret ids. Test it before with test_connector. Never ask for API keys: the owner enters them in the app.
tools.name: propose_connector

refused.approve: only the owner approves a connector, in the app (Ustawienia > Konektory)
refused.converter: propose_connector takes the connector directory only; nothing is run

tools.description: Installed connectors: id, name, module, kind, status (pending / approved / changed / disabled), the last run's outcome, error kind and time, and how many accounts of this profile use each; and the connector catalog shipped with the app (id, name, module, kind, version, maintainer, last verified, stale, valid, installed status). Run messages, logs, parameters and keys stay in the app. The app runs an installed connector only after the owner approves it in the app (Ustawienia > Konektory); MCP calls never install as approved and never approve.
tools.name: connectors
